review:
A 5x4 western where the four-row Hunter xNudge wild can land on any reel and always nudges into view, +1 multiplier per nudge. Two sheriff badges trigger Shoot Out, turning every low card symbol on the middle reels wild.

Three scatters let you choose: eight Hunter Spins with at least one Hunter wild every spin, or the swingier Gunslinger Spins. High volatility, 13,950x max, and a friendly 40% hit rate.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
